newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to refrain from intervening in the banking system Monday, but some form of system repurchase agreement (RP) operation could not be ruled out, economists said.
Although the Fed faced an add need, an outstanding 14-day system RP should provide the necessary liquidity, they said.
Fed funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, near the Fed's current official target of 5.50.
On Friday fed funds traded between 4.75 and 5.5 percent, with an average of 5.32 percent for the day. The weekly average last week was 5.37 percent.
